subject.title: [Feature]: Allow Codex harness configured app-server provider IDs

question: Should the Codex plugin expose `plugins.entries.codex.config.appServer.providerIds` as the supported way for the bundled app-server harness to claim Codex-configured custom provider IDs?
rationale: The source-level limitation is real, but the proposed solution adds a compatibility-sensitive provider-routing config knob that repository policy treats as maintainer product direction.

options.title: Accept Allowlist With Parser Fix
options.body: Keep the linked PR direction if it routes `providerIds` through the strict Codex config parser and preserves the existing `codex`/`openai` defaults.

options.title: Derive From Codex Configuration
options.body: Ask for a design that discovers claimable provider IDs from Codex config or another existing contract instead of adding an OpenClaw allowlist.

options.title: Defer Custom Providers
options.body: Keep the harness limited to `codex` and `openai` until maintainers want custom Codex model providers in OpenClaw routing.

recommendation.title: Accept Allowlist With Parser Fix
recommendation.body: Keep the linked PR direction if it routes `providerIds` through the strict Codex config parser and preserves the existing `codex`/`openai` defaults.

likelyOwner.reason: The original Codex app-server harness and selection behavior history is the strongest signal for this product/config-boundary decision.
